tool_schemas.name: list_shadcn_components
tool_schemas.description: Lists components in our curated shadcn/ui catalog and returns a paged result set filtered by status, category, tag, and/or shadcnVersion, sorted by the requested field and order; pagination uses an opaque cursor where the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort value is invalid, limit is outside 1–100, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to access the catalog and RATE_LIMITED when listing exceeds analytics/rate limits.

tag.description: Filter components to those containing this tag in their tags array.

shadcnVersion.description: Filter components by shadcn/ui version string.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy field.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_component_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full reference entry for a single component identified by componentName, including its description, props, installation notes, tags/category, publication status, and version metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if componentName is empty or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if no component exists with that name (or it is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to access component details and RATE_LIMITED when requests exceed analytics/rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: get_component_examples
tool_schemas.description: Returns the runnable usage examples associated with the specified componentName. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if componentName is empty or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the component does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to access examples and RATE_LIMITED when requests exceed analytics/rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: search_components
tool_schemas.description: Searches component metadata and example text for the provided query and returns matching components ordered by relevance; each request is recorded for analytics and rate limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or otherwise invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to search and RATE_LIMITED when search volume exceeds analytics/rate limits.

query.description: Search query to find relevant components

tool_schemas.name: get_shadcn_component
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single component by its componentName (slug) and returns its catalog metadata. Hidden components are never returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if componentName is empty or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the component does not exist or is not visible to you, and UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to access component metadata.

tool_schemas.name: create_shadcn_component
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new component entry in the curated catalog. Returns the created component record. Refuses duplicate slugs, invalid fields, or unauthorized writes. Note: newly created components may be hidden by status but hidden components are not returned by read endpoints.

slug.description: URL-safe unique slug for the component (e.g., "alert-dialog").

tags.description: Tags used for filtering and search.

source_url.description: Upstream reference URL (repo/docs) for this component.

shadcn_version.description: shadcn/ui version string this entry targets.

tool_schemas.name: update_shadcn_component
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing component identified by componentName (slug). Returns the updated component record. Refuses invalid transitions or attempts to set a hidden component via any read-only field. Hidden components are never returned by read endpoints.

componentName.description: Name (slug) of the shadcn/ui component to update.

tags.description: Tags used for filtering and search.

source_url.description: Upstream reference URL (repo/docs) for this component.

shadcn_version.description: shadcn/ui version string this entry targets.

status.description: Set the component publication status. Allowed transitions: active→deprecated|hidden; deprecated→active|hidden; hidden→active.

tool_schemas.name: create_component_details
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new component_details revision for the given componentName. Returns the created revision row. Refuses creation if the component does not exist or is hidden, or if inputs are invalid. Writes that affect description_md or props_schema trigger recomputation of the parent component search_text within the same transaction or a guaranteed background job.

componentName.description: Name (slug) of the shadcn/ui component this revision belongs to.

revision.description: Monotonic revision number for this component.

props_schema.description: JSON schema describing the component props.

dependencies.description: List of dependency package names or identifiers.

status.description: Initial lifecycle state for this revision. If set to active, the previously active revision (if any) is atomically marked superseded so only one active remains.

tool_schemas.name: update_component_details_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the lifecycle status of a component_details revision by id. Returns the updated revision row. Enforces lifecycle rules: draft→active; active→superseded; superseded has no outbound transitions. When promoting to active, any previously active revision for the same component is atomically marked superseded.

id.description: Primary key of the component_details revision to transition.

status.description: Target status for the revision. Allowed transitions depend on current status.

metadata.name: shadcn/ui Component Reference Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a curated, versioned catalog of shadcn/ui components, their documentation (descriptions, props, installation notes), and runnable usage examples. It also records search queries for basic analytics/rate limiting and supports keyword search over component metadata and example text.
